events.title: Appearance target defined
events.summary: The internally dated Version 15 specifies a white polycarbonate cover with satin VDI15 texture, matched to the Elvis main switch. It is an appearance target, not the final resin certificate. Credit: NOON/Locoroll.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Hook stamping negotiation
events.summary: Tongda proposed a 4 mm hook cut; Locoroll asked for a 2 mm minimum, which the supplier confirmed was workable. Credit: Tongda and Locoroll.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Initial cover-stack analysis
events.summary: The perimeter and snap studies separated entry clearance from seating. Their conclusions depended on assumed or borrowed drawing tolerances. Credit: Colin Davis, Function Engineering.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Earlier hardness samples pass
events.summary: Three Waldo samples pass the stated H-pencil check at 1 kgf. The result belongs to this sample set. Credit: FIH.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Solvent-test observations
events.summary: The EVT2 table records three Waldo samples at Level 0 under its listed chemical exposures. Sample identities do not establish the final resin or coating. Credit: FIH; Jaz Yang and Sunny Yen.
events.date_basis: EVT2 solvent report start/report/finish date on physical pp191/193. Result table p202 belongs to this report; no unique Waldo serial or separate test date given.

events.title: Perimeter movement threatens engagement
events.summary: Allowing cover movement shows how positive centered overlap can still permit disengagement. The report proposes coordinated slot, snap-tip and perimeter-gap changes. Credit: Function Engineering.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Z seating needs controlled surfaces
events.summary: The revised study proposes local mating pads and tighter dimensional control to address incomplete seating or looseness. Credit: Function Engineering.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: System removal check
events.summary: The status sheet records difficult removal after dust exposure, then a passing repeat check with the device, Bazooka and Waldo together. It does not identify a causal geometry change. Credit: FIH.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Snap changes visible in drawing review
events.summary: Colin Davis observes that snap-fit adjustments appear mostly implemented, while chassis slot and datum concerns remain. This is a drawing-review state, without a demonstrated final hardware join. Credit: Colin Davis, Function Engineering.

events.title: Later hardness set fails
events.summary: Three later Waldo samples fail the stated H-pencil check at 1 kgf. The separate sample populations do not isolate a material or coating cause. Credit: FIH.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Protective-film bubbles
events.summary: Packaging review photographs show bubbles under film on recognizable Waldo covers; the final remedy is not established. Credit: Shared packaging review.
events.date_basis: Document/report/message or stated event date, distinguished in limits; never filesystem/capture date.

events.title: Prototype cover order
events.summary: The order lists nylon-12 laser-sintered finish plates. It does not establish received parts or successful fit. Credit: Locoroll procurement record.

events.title: Prototype manufacturing alternatives
events.summary: Quotes consider machined chassis in several metals and covers made by machining or stereolithography. These are alternatives, not a final material or process selection. Credit: Supplier quotations.

verification.scope: Exact existing reader event wording, order, date precision and credit; visualization adds no factual claim. Unknown dates remain unknown.
